name: @kitstak/mail
description: KitStak platform mail: which provider is in use and one Resend send (fetch, no SDK, idempotent). Server only. Used by @kitstak/billing/emails for codes, invites and billing mail, and by WMS for password resets, invites and report links when a company has no SMTP of its own. TypeScript source-shipped (consumers transpile via Next transpilePackages).
